questions.question:
Which two numbers and two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

5 + 44 - 8 × 25 = 203

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(60, 5, 6)

(48, 8, 3)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed in the given sets is:

(Second term **×** Third term) **× 2** = First term

Now we apply the pattern on the given sets:

(60, 5, 6)

(__5 **× **6__) × 2 = 60

__**30 × 2**__ = 60

60 = 60

(48, 8, 3)

(__8 × 3__) × 2 = 48

__24 × 2__ = 48

48 = 48

Now we apply the pattern on the given options:

Option 1) (17, 3, 4)

(__3 × 4__) × 2 = 17

__12 × 2__ = 17

24 ≠ 17

Option 2) (25, 4, 6)

(__4 × 6__) × 2 = 25

__24 × 2__ = 25

48 ≠ 25

Option 3) (24, 4, 3)

(__4 × 3__) × 2 = 24

__12 × 2__ = 24

**24 = 24**

Option 4) (25, 4, 3)

(__4 × 3__) × 2 = 25

__12 × 2__ = 25

24 ≠ 25

So, **(24, 4, 3)** follows the same pattern as the given sets.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
A & B means ‘A is the son of B’

A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A % B means ‘A is the father of B’

A - B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A * B means ‘A is the wife of B’

If C # D @ E % Z & L # M - N * P, then how is Z related to N?
questions.solution:
Given:

 
 

 A & B
 A is the son of B
 
 

 A # B
 A is the sister of B
 
 

 A @ B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A % B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A - B
 A is the daughter of B
 
 

 A * B
 A is the wife of B
 
 

Now we substitute the values in the given equation:

C # D @ E % Z & L # M - N * P means C is the sister of D, D is the brother of E, E is the father of Z, Z is the son of L, L is the sister of M, M is the daughter of N, N is the wife of P.

Now we draw a chart by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d5a935d623a41a2055d7118a30cb95a4dc5b577d68921c46f443937a8a4ad0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/561853c4c9dcde18de53ffbe891b8218c4c7525d5fb89ca2afc155e313e616f3.png] 

From the chart we can see that **Z is the grandson of N.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:

E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

questions.solution:

**(Second term + Third term)² = First term**

Now we apply the pattern on the given sets:

(144, 9, 3)

(__**9 + 3**__)² = 144

(12)2 = 144

144 = 144

(225, 7, 8)

(__7 + 8__)2 = 225

(15)2 = 225

225 = 225

Now we apply the pattern on the given options:

Option 1) (168, 5, 8)

(__5 + 8__)2 = 168

(13)2 = 168

169 ≠ 168

Option 2) (64, 5, 3) 

(__5 + 3__)2 = 64

(8)2 = 64

**64 = 64**

Option 3) (81, 6, 2)

(__6 + 2__)2 = 81

(8)2 = 81

64 ≠ 81

Option 4) (120, 7, 4)

(__7 + 4__)2 = 120

(11)2 = 120

121 ≠ 120

So, **(64, 5, 3) follows the same pattern as the given sets.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pens are plates.

All plates are trays.

Some trays are boxes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boxes are plates.

II. Some trays are pens.

III. Some boxes are pens.

IV. No tray is a plate.
questions.solution:
Statements:

All pens are plates.

All plates are trays.

Some trays are boxes.

**Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e682699572b5388c49c0ac70471f28e51ea345c40336cb453d815b00047bfaad.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some boxes are plates→ Does not follow → There is no information that connects plates & boxes thus the conclusion does not follow.

II. Some trays are pens→ Follow → We have 'all pens are plates' and 'all plates are trays' which means some trays are pens and the Some trays are pens is definitely follow.

III. Some boxes are pens→ Does not follow → There is no information that connects pens & boxes thus the conclusion does not follow.

IV. No tray is a plate → Does not follow → Since all plates are trays, definitely some trays are plates therefore the conclusion does not follow.

So, **only conclusion II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: If A × B means that A is the father of B, A + B means that A is the mother of B, A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that A is the paternal uncle of C?
questions.solution:
Given:

 
 

 A × B 
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A + B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A ÷ B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

Now we substitute the values in the given options:

Option 1) A ÷ C + B means,

A is the brother of C, C is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09c08ad2b2e4e0d5503ae990d589659a485fc11dcc0f07be766672405c065d7d.png] Here A is the brother of C so A cannot be the paternal uncle of C.

Option 2) A ÷ B + C means,

A is the brother of B, B is the mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/514fb50ed22a4542b6774cba7e547aed01ab226df691c0769c95fa0befb9c5fc.png] Here A is maternal uncle of C so A cannot be the paternal uncle of C.

Option 3) A + B ÷ C means,

A is the mother of B, B is the brother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c744b9449bab692da5b8f87ca64ba4a96f6cc81db507d434fc11493bda9d083a.png] Here A is the mother of C so A cannot be the paternal uncle of C.

Option 4) A ÷ B × C means,

A is the brother of B, B is the father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad51cc7ba59063b21d1a34692d491caf614a2b7d2310fa402a6cf282b1f1e152.png] Here **A is the paternal uncle of C.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

24 = 24

120 = 120

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some Z are F.

II. All G are Z.

**Conclusion:**

I. No F is G.

II. Some G are not F.

III. No F is Z.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. Some Z are F.

II. All G are Z.

**Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58b74c442d951128164e56c4dbfba6637b45572fdf4db9a40c2ee61cb9876771.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No F is G → Does not follow → We don't have any information about G and F so the conclusion cannot be drawn.

II. Some G are not F → Does not follow → We don't have any information about G and F so the conclusion cannot be drawn.

III. No F is Z → Does not follow → We have 'some Z are F' which means some F are Z thus the conclusion does not follow.

So, **neither conclusion follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
